slides.texte_overlay:
How to earn real respect
without ever shouting
Do your job better than expected. Quality work speaks louder than any argument. People respect the man whose results nobody in the room can question.
Set boundaries early and kindly. "I don't answer work messages after eight." Saying it calmly on day one is far easier than fighting about it on day ninety.
Don't laugh at jokes that put others down. A neutral face is enough. Quietly refusing to join in tells everyone exactly what kind of man you are and what you stand for.
Stay calm when you're criticised. "Thanks, I'll think about that." Taking feedback without getting defensive shows a strength people rarely forget.
Before: I raised my voice to be heard. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and calm arguments that people actually stop and listen to.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I raised my voice to be heard. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Now people listen to my calm arguments.

slides.texte_overlay: Treat everyone with the same respect. The CEO and the intern get the same handshake. People respect a man whose manners don't depend on someone's title.
Know when to stay silent. Not every comment deserves an answer. Choosing your battles carefully makes the ones you do pick matter far more to everyone.
